source: ISC2 CCSP Certification Exam Outline, effective August 1, 2026 (topic names condensed; see the official PDF for the authoritative wording)

topics.title: Understand cloud computing concepts
topics.zh: 理解雲端運算概念
bullets: Roles and responsibilities (customer, CSP, partner, broker, regulator)
Essential characteristics (on-demand self-service, broad network access, multi-tenancy, rapid elasticity and scalability, resource pooling, measured service)
Building block technologies (virtualization, storage, networking, databases, orchestration)

topics.title: Describe cloud reference architecture
topics.zh: 描述雲端參考架構
bullets: Cloud service capabilities (application, platform, infrastructure capability types)
Cloud deployment models (public, private, hybrid, community, multi-cloud)

Cloud shared considerations (interoperability, portability, reversibility, availability, security, privacy, resiliency, performance, governance, maintenance and versioning, SLA, auditability, regulatory, outsourcing)
Impact of related technologies (data science, ML, AI, blockchain, IoT, containers, quantum, edge, confidential computing)

topics.title: Understand security concepts relevant to cloud computing
topics.zh: 理解與雲端相關的安全概念
bullets: Identity and access control (user, privilege, service access)
Data and media sanitization (overwriting, cryptographic erase)
Network security (network security groups, traffic inspection, geofencing)
Virtualization security (hypervisor, container, ephemeral computing, serverless, isolation)
Security hygiene (patching, baselining, immutable architecture, hardening)

topics.title: Understand design principles of secure cloud computing
topics.zh: 理解安全雲端設計原則
bullets: Functional security requirements (portability, interoperability, vendor lock-in)
Security considerations and responsibilities per SaaS, IaaS, PaaS
Cloud design patterns (SANS principles, Well-Architected Framework, CSA Enterprise Architecture, secure by design)

topics.title: Evaluate Cloud Service Providers (CSP)
topics.zh: 評估雲端服務供應商

topics.title: Comprehend Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML)
topics.zh: 理解 AI/ML

topics.title: Describe cloud data concepts
topics.zh: 描述雲端資料概念

topics.title: Design and implement cloud data storage architectures
topics.zh: 設計與實作雲端資料儲存架構
bullets: Storage types (long-term, ephemeral, raw, object, volume)

topics.title: Design and apply data security technologies and strategies
topics.zh: 設計與應用資料安全技術與策略

topics.title: Implement data discovery
topics.zh: 實作資料探索

topics.title: Plan and implement data classification
topics.zh: 規劃與實作資料分類

topics.title: Design and implement Information Rights Management (IRM)
topics.zh: 設計與實作資訊權限管理
bullets: Appropriate tools (issuing and revocation of certificates)

topics.title: Plan and implement data retention, deletion and archiving policies
topics.zh: 規劃與實作資料保存、刪除與封存政策

topics.title: Design and implement auditability, traceability and accountability of data events
topics.zh: 設計與實作資料事件的可稽核性、可追溯性與問責
bullets: Event sources and event attributes (identity, IP address, geolocation)
Logging, storage and analysis of data events

topics.title: Comprehend data protection of AI and ML data
topics.zh: 理解 AI/ML 資料保護
bullets: Data set and model security (validation, verification)

domains.title: Cloud Platform and Infrastructure Security
domains.zh: 雲端平台與基礎設施安全

topics.title: Comprehend cloud infrastructure components
topics.zh: 理解雲端基礎設施元件

topics.title: Design a secure data center
topics.zh: 設計安全的資料中心

topics.title: Analyze risks associated with cloud infrastructure and platforms
topics.zh: 分析雲端基礎設施與平台風險

topics.title: Plan and implementation of security controls
topics.zh: 規劃與實作安全控制
bullets: Identification, authentication and authorization in cloud environments
Audit mechanisms (log collection, correlation, packet capture)

topics.title: Plan Business Continuity (BC) and Disaster Recovery (DR)
topics.zh: 規劃營運持續與災難復原
bullets: Business requirements (RTO, RPO, recovery service level)
Creation, implementation and testing of plan

topics.title: Advocate training and awareness for application security
topics.zh: 倡導應用程式安全訓練與意識
bullets: Common cloud vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, ASVS, API Top 10, Top 10 for LLM Applications, SANS Top 25)

topics.title: Describe the Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) process
topics.zh: 描述安全軟體開發生命週期
bullets: Phases and methodologies (design, code, test, maintain, waterfall vs agile)

topics.title: Apply the Secure SDLC
topics.zh: 應用安全 SDLC
bullets: Cloud-specific risks (shared technology, CSP insider threats, lack of visibility and control, legal and jurisdiction issues)

topics.title: Apply cloud software assurance and validation
topics.zh: 應用雲端軟體保證與驗證
bullets: Security testing methodologies (blackbox, whitebox, SCA, IAST, SAST, DAST)

topics.title: Use verified secure software
topics.zh: 使用經驗證的安全軟體
bullets: Supply-chain management (vendor assessment, integrity, authenticity, licensing)

topics.title: Comprehend and apply the specifics of cloud application architecture
topics.zh: 理解並應用雲端應用架構特性
bullets: Supplemental security components (WAF, DAM, XML firewalls, API gateway, load balancer)
Application virtualization and orchestration (microservices, containers, Docker, Kubernetes)

topics.title: Design appropriate Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions
topics.zh: 設計適當的 IAM 解決方案

topics.title: Build and implement physical and logical infrastructure for cloud environment
topics.zh: 建置雲端環境的實體與邏輯基礎設施
bullets: Installation and configuration of management plane tools
Virtual hardware security configuration (network, storage, memory, CPU, hypervisor type 1 and 2)
Installation of guest OS virtualization toolsets

topics.title: Operate and maintain physical and logical infrastructure for cloud environment
topics.zh: 維運雲端環境的實體與邏輯基礎設施
bullets: Access controls for local and remote access (RDP, SSH, console, jumpboxes, virtual client, SSO)
Secure network configuration (VLAN, TLS, DHCP, DNSSEC, VPN)
Network security controls (firewalls, IDS, IPS, honeypots, vulnerability assessments, NSG, bastion host, segmentation)
OS hardening through baselines, monitoring and remediation
Availability of clustered hosts (DRS, dynamic optimization, storage clusters, maintenance mode, HA)
Host and guest OS backup and restore

topics.title: Implement operational controls and standards
topics.zh: 實作營運控制與標準
bullets: Frameworks: NIST, ISO, HIPAA, COBIT, CIS Controls, COSO, ITIL, ISO/IEC 20000-1

topics.title: Support digital forensics
topics.zh: 支援數位鑑識
bullets: Collecting, acquiring and preserving digital evidence

topics.title: Manage communication with relevant parties
topics.zh: 管理與相關方的溝通

topics.title: Manage security operations
topics.zh: 管理安全營運
bullets: Intelligent monitoring of security controls (firewalls, IDS, IPS, honeypots, NSG, AI)
Log capture and analysis (SIEM, log management, threat intelligence)

topics.title: Articulate legal requirements and unique risks within the cloud environment
topics.zh: 闡述雲端環境的法律要求與特有風險
bullets: Evaluation of legal risks specific to cloud computing
Legal and regulatory frameworks and guidelines

topics.title: Understand privacy requirements
topics.zh: 理解隱私要求
bullets: Contractual vs regulated private data (PHI, PII)
Country-specific legislation (FERPA, PIPEDA, GDPR, HIPAA, India DPDP Act)

topics.title: Understand audit processes, methodologies, and required adaptations for a cloud environment
topics.zh: 理解稽核流程、方法與雲端調整
bullets: Assurance challenges of virtualization and cloud
Types of audit reports (SSAE, SOC, ISAE)
Specialized compliance for highly regulated industries (NERC CIP, HIPAA, HITECH, PCI)

topics.title: Understand implications of cloud to enterprise risk management
topics.zh: 理解雲端對企業風險管理的影響
bullets: Data roles (owner, controller, custodian, processor, steward)
Regulatory transparency requirements (breach notification, SOX, GDPR)
Risk treatment (avoid, mitigate, transfer, share, accept)
Assessment of risk environment (service, vendor, infrastructure, business)

topics.title: Understand outsourcing and cloud contract design
topics.zh: 理解外包與雲端合約設計
bullets: Contract management (right to audit, metrics, definitions, termination, litigation, assurance, compliance, access to cloud/data, cyber risk insurance, data ownership, security requirements)
